original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚奥孙州警方宣布一名派系NURTW主席因谋杀被通缉
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚奥孙州警察局长Ibrahim Zungura宣布，全国道路运输工人工会（NURTW）奥孙州派系主席Nurudeen Alowonle因谋杀Olalekan Oyeyemi（又名Emir）而被通缉。警方称已逮捕包括Alowonle的私人助理和一名Amotekun Corps成员在内的六名嫌疑人，他们与9月13日在Ile-Ife一处汽车站发生的这起杀人案有关。警方还在加紧追捕另一名NURTW负责人Ojo Adeyemi。上述信息目前仅来自单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 奥孙州警方宣布派系NURTW主席Nurudeen Alowonle因谋杀被通缉
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Osun State Commissioner of Police, Ibrahim Zungura, has declared the factional Chairman of the National Union of Road Transport Workers in Osun State, Nurudeen Alowonle, wanted for the murder of Olalekan Oyeyemi

key_facts.fact: 六名嫌疑人已被逮捕，包括Alowonle的私人助理和一名Amotekun Corps成员
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He said six people, including Alowonle’s Personal Assistant and an operative of the Amotekun Corps, have been arrested in connection with the September 13 killing of Emir at a motor park in Ile-Ife.

key_facts.fact: 谋杀案发生于9月13日Ile-Ife一处汽车站
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the September 13 killing of Emir at a motor park in Ile-Ife

key_facts.fact: 警方还在追捕另一名NURTW负责人Ojo Adeyemi
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: operatives were intensifying efforts to arrest another NURTW chief, Ojo Adeyemi, over the murder

uncertainties: 目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
Alowonle尚未被抓获，相关指控有待司法程序确认
